mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows a PatchRequest to mutate fields on a Done task without a status change, directly violating FR-011. The injection forces exactly such a violating PatchRequest to exist.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_ClosedTaskEditViolation { some pr: PatchRequest | pr.pr_target.task_status = Done and pr.pr_mutates_fields = BTrue and no pr.pr_new_status }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows two DeletionLogEntry atoms to share the same DeletedTaskId, simulating an overwrite/mutation of an append-only log entry. The injection forces such a collision to exist.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AppendOnlyViolation { some disj e1, e2: DeletionLogEntry | e1.dle_task_id = e2.dle_task_id }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows a DeletedTaskId to exist with no corresponding DeletionLogEntry, meaning a deletion was not logged — violating FR-018 completeness. The injection forces an unlogged DeletedTaskId to exist.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_DeletionLogCompletenessViolation { some dtid: DeletedTaskId | no dle: DeletionLogEntry | dle.dle_task_id = dtid }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows a PatchRequest whose caller has no Token, simulating an unauthenticated edit reaching the handler — the core violation of FR-001. The injection forces such a request to exist.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_UnauthenticatedPatchViolation { some pr: PatchRequest | no tok: Token | tok.token_owner = pr.pr_caller }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows a Task whose creator does not correspond to any token-owning member, meaning the creator identity was not taken from the authentication context — violating FR-002 and FR-009. The injection forces such a task to exist.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_CreatorAuthViolation { some t: Task | no tok: Token | tok.token_owner = t.task_creator }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows a Task with an assignee that is not in the Member sig (a non-member being assigned), violating FR-008's requirement that assignees are current workspace members. The injection forces a task with an out-of-member-set assignee; since Task.task_assignee is typed as lone Member this is modelled by forcing a task with a non-empty assignee while Member is empty — approximated here by requiring the assignee set to be non-empty while no Member has a token.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AssigneeNotMemberViolation { some t: Task | some t.task_assignee and t.task_assignee not in Token.token_owner }
